text.description_html:
5" Long Sleek Modern Door Stop

Modern design solid brass door stop with satin nickel finish and white bumper tip. Easy to install with included mounting hardware.

These extra long door stops screw onto the baseboard casement, door bottom or wall anchor, to protect not just the wall and door, but your door knob or lever as well.

Specifications for First Impressions 457/5-US15 Door Stop

  • Total Length: 5"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Rubber Bumper: White
  • Satin Nickel Finish

*Sold Individually
